title: Boy on Foggy Beach, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white square snapshot dated April 1967 showing a young boy walking towards the camera on a misty, foggy beach. He smiles while holding out a small stick or piece of driftwood. The damp sand shows footprints and vehicle tire tracks, fading into dense fog over the ocean horizon. Printed with scalloped borders and photo processing stamp APR 67 along the right margin.
